mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id, tenant_id, name, doc_type, file_path, file_size, file_hash, parse_status, parse_error, chunk_count, permission_level, allowed_roles, created_by, created_at, updated_at, indexed_at FROM kb_document WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, kb_id, tenant_id, name, doc_type, file_path, file_size, file_hash, parse_status, parse_error, chunk_count, permission_level, allowed_roles, created_by, created_at, updated_at, indexed_at FROM kb_document WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND parse_status = #{parseStatus} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT id, kb_id, tenant_id, name, doc_type, file_path, file_size, file_hash, parse_status, parse_error, chunk_count, permission_level, allowed_roles, created_by, created_at, updated_at, indexed_at FROM kb_document WHERE file_hash = #{fileHash} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_document WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}

SELECT id, kb_id, tenant_id, name, doc_type, file_path, file_size, file_hash, parse_status, parse_error, chunk_count, permission_level, allowed_roles, created_by, created_at, updated_at, indexed_at FROM kb_document WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_document WHERE parse_status = #{parseStatus}

SELECT d.id, d.kb_id AS "kbId", d.tenant_id AS "tenantId", d.name, d.doc_type AS "docType", d.file_size AS "fileSize", d.parse_status AS "parseStatus", d.parse_error AS "parseError", d.chunk_count AS "chunkCount", d.created_by AS "createdBy", d.created_at AS "createdAt", d.updated_at AS "updatedAt", d.indexed_at AS "indexedAt", kb.name AS "kbName", org.name AS "orgName", usr.username AS "creatorUsername" FROM kb_document d LEFT JOIN kb_knowledge_base kb ON kb.id = d.kb_id LEFT JOIN sys_organization org ON org.org_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN biz_user_account usr ON usr.user_id = d.created_by
ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT d.id, d.kb_id AS "kbId", d.tenant_id AS "tenantId", d.name, d.parse_status AS "parseStatus", d.parse_error AS "parseError", d.updated_at AS "updatedAt", kb.name AS "kbName", org.name AS "orgName" FROM kb_document d LEFT JOIN kb_knowledge_base kb ON kb.id = d.kb_id LEFT JOIN sys_organization org ON org.org_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.parse_status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document (kb_id, tenant_id, name, doc_type, file_path, file_size, file_hash, parse_status, parse_error, chunk_count, permission_level, allowed_roles, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{docType}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileHash}, #{parseStatus}, #{parseError}, #{chunkCount}, #{permissionLevel}, #{allowedRoles}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_document SET parse_status = #{parseStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE kb_document SET parse_status = #{parseStatus}, parse_error = #{parseError}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
